title: Telemetry Budget v1
description: Bounded telemetry budget policy for Rig Relay. Defines caps on remote data exports so shared datasets remain analyzable on local hardware without unbounded growth.

max_bundle_mb.description: Maximum upload bundle size in megabytes. Default: 100.

max_rows_per_dataset.description: Maximum rows per exported dataset file. Default: 100000.

max_semantic_snippets_per_session.description: Maximum semantic change snippets per session. Default: 200.

raw_retention_days.description: Local retention period for raw observability logs. Default: 14.

derived_retention_days.description: Local retention period for derived datasets. Default: 180.

upload_mode.description: Upload strategy: rollup counts + representative samples, rollup only, full derived datasets, or disabled.
